# The link clip spec can read the chart before its links are drawn

Owned: the spec is mine (#21692, PR #21699) and its fix follows today; not offered to contributors.

## Context

CI on PR #21732 at `9b1202433f` (run 44871811594, `e2e-engine (7/15)`) failed one test whose example that PR does not touch:

```
test/playwright/e2e/gantt/LinkClip.spec.mjs:66:5 › gantt/zoom scrolled 2400 px draws its links in the chart, never over the locked columns
Error: expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality
Expected: true
Received: false
```

On `dev` `07b6cbd213` the spec passes 6 of 6 locally (`--repeat-each 3`). The failing line is the last one: no link painted in the chart.

## The Problem

After the scroll the test waits for `gantt.timelineColumn.scrollLeft` to reach the value and for two equal screenshots, then asks whether links paint in the table and then in the chart. The dependency layer redraws after a scroll on its own schedule, so two equal frames can come before the links are back. Then the chart check fails, which is the flake. The worse half comes first: the table check passes with no link on screen at all, so on such a run it witnesses nothing.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: n/a — a test's race; it calls no product behaviour wrong.

- `linksPaintIn(page, clip)` compares a region's pixels with the dependency layer shown and hidden; it restores the layer, so it can be polled.
- `Neo.gantt.Container` moves the layer from the header toolbar's `scrollLeft` (`bindTimelineSubscriptions`), a separate path from the `timelineColumn.scrollLeft` the test waits on.

## The Fix

Poll until links paint in the chart (`expect.poll(() => linksPaintIn(page, chart)).toBe(true)`), and only then assert that none paints in the table.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The table check runs only after links paint in the chart, so it never passes on an empty layer.
- [ ] `LinkClip.spec.mjs` passes 10 runs in a row locally (`--repeat-each 5`).

## Out of Scope

- When the dependency layer redraws after a scroll.
- Other specs' flakes on hosted runners (for example Vega's defect-note on `ThumbDragPause.spec.mjs`).
